name: dev-workflow
description: Daily development workflow for ZCode: 7 flow skills (change-plan, debug, test-changed, review, commit-review, release-check, doc-gen) with each hand-off step naming the subagent to dispatch, task-level plan files under .devflow and docs/plans, a gated multi-round review protocol, /handoff session contract persistence, a SessionStart repo snapshot, and 23 specialist subagents auto-installed into ~/.zcode/agents. Every subagent also carries the codegraph tools for locating code and call relations, so the codegraph plugin must be installed and enabled.
